ACResult.description:
A full round against one AC. `attacks` is in the same order as the
request's attack list.
ACResult.title: ACResult

AttackEntry.description:
One attack roll in a round, with everything that can differ between
attacks -- including whether this particular attack uses power attack
(GWM/Sharpshooter). A round is a list of these; repeat an entry for
Extra Attack rather than using a count.
AttackEntry.title: AttackEntry

AttackResult.description:
One attack's numbers against one AC, with its own power-attack
setting applied.
AttackResult.title: AttackResult

BuildCalculateRequest.description: AC list to run a saved build's stored attacks against.
BuildCalculateRequest.title: BuildCalculateRequest

BuildCreate.description: Everything required to save a new build.
BuildCreate.title: BuildCreate

BuildUpdate.description:
A partial update -- send only what changes. `attacks`, if sent,
replaces the whole list; `once_per_turn: null` removes it. The merged
build must still be valid (see BuildBase).
BuildUpdate.title: BuildUpdate

CharacterRead.description: A saved character: the sheet plus its id and timestamps.
CharacterRead.title: CharacterRead

CharacterRunRequest.description: Run a saved character: target ACs plus this round's toggles.
CharacterRunRequest.title: CharacterRunRequest

CharacterSheet.description:
What the player enters. Everything else (proficiency, attacks per
round, Sneak Attack dice, crit range) is derived from the level.
CharacterSheet.title: CharacterSheet

DerivedRound.description:
The round a character makes: attack entries plus Sneak Attack, in
exactly the shape /api/calculate and builds take.
DerivedRound.title: DerivedRound

OncePerTurn.description:
Extra damage added once per turn, to the first eligible attack that
hits -- Sneak Attack, or any similar rider. Generic on purpose: the name
is just a label, and which attacks qualify is set per attack.
OncePerTurn.title: OncePerTurn

OncePerTurnResult.description: The round's once-per-turn damage against one AC.
OncePerTurnResult.title: OncePerTurnResult

RoundToggles.description:
Situational choices for one round -- set when calculating, not
stored on the character.
RoundToggles.title: RoundToggles

SaveAsBuildRequest.description:
Snapshot a character's derived round as a build. The build doesn't
follow later changes to the character.
SaveAsBuildRequest.title: SaveAsBuildRequest

SrdWeapon.description: A weapon from the 2014 SRD weapons table (see app/srd.py).
SrdWeapon.title: SrdWeapon

WeaponChoice.description: A wielded weapon: either an SRD weapon by key or a custom profile.
WeaponChoice.title: WeaponChoice

WeaponProfile.description: A weapon's damage and properties -- an SRD weapon, or a custom one.
WeaponProfile.title: WeaponProfile

schema.title: Response List Builds Api Builds Get

post.description:
Run a saved build's stored attacks (and once-per-turn damage) against
a list of ACs -- same math as /api/calculate, just pulling the round
from the database.

schema.title: Response List Characters Api Characters Get

post.description:
Derive a character's round and run it against a list of ACs -- the
same numbers /api/calculate gives for the derived attacks.
The attack entries (and Sneak Attack) a character makes in a round.

put.description:
Replace the whole sheet -- its rules span fields (e.g. off-hand vs.
grip), so it's edited and validated as one unit rather than patched.

post.description:
Save the character's derived round (with these toggles) as a build,
to compare against other builds. A snapshot: later edits to the
character don't change it.

get.description: The 2014 SRD weapons table (SRD 5.1, CC-BY-4.0 -- see app/srd.py).

schema.title: Response List Srd Weapons Api Srd Weapons Get
